race.title: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Handicap Chase
race.verdict: Assuming he copes with a 4-day turnaround, HARD STARE can put his fitness to good use and build on what was a promising chasing debut at Plumpton on Monday. Ted The Thief lacks an outing but is the obvious threat. HARD STARE TED THE THIEF (IRE) SWEET NIGHTINGALE
race.bettingForecast: Ted The Thief (2/1), Hard Stare (9/4), Steal The Moves (9/2), Sweet Nightingale (13/2), My Own Lovely Lee (7/1), Pawpaw (20/1)
